statutory_dues.text:
The Company does not have liability in respect of Service tax,
Duty of Excise, Sales tax and Value Added Tax during the year
since effective 1st July, 2017, these statutory dues has been
subsumed into GST.
a. The Company is regular in depositing Undisputed
Statutory Dues, including Goods and Service Tax,
Provident Fund, Employees’ State Insurance, Income
Tax, Duty of Customs, Cess and any other statutory
dues with appropriate authorities, where applicable.
There are no undisputed amounts payable in respect of
such statutory dues which have remained outstanding
as at 31st March, 2024 for a period of more than six
months from the date they became payable.
b. According to the records of the Company, does not have
any dues outstanding of income tax, sales tax, service
tax, duty of customs, duty of excise, goods and service
tax and value added tax on account of any dispute.
